value.rationale: The dodecahedron and its P3-devoid/second independence complex are intrinsically natural objects, and exact integral homotopy is a potentially worthwhile invariant. But multiple earlier-dated complete mathematical results already give the exact same Ind_2(GP(10,2)) ≃ S6 classification, one together with the extra nontrivial rotation character. The present different pivot order and signed degree vector (1,1) produce a useful independent reproduction, not a new previously unknown invariant, structural boundary, or nontrivial refinement.
